properties.summary: Proposed land use, nothing adopted: the seven zones of the proposed Specific Plan traced from Figure 5 of the City of Suisun City's Notice of Preparation (SCH 2025110452, Nov 2025), and the proposed Area Plan's Travis Protection Zone and Lambie Industrial Park from its Figure 2. Streets and state routes are folded into the nearest zone (the ~153 acres of Caltrans right-of-way and Delta Camp are not split out), Neighborhood Mixed Use isn't split by Travis compatibility zone because the figure doesn't draw that line, and no buildings are drawn. All boundaries are approximate.
properties.note: Proposed land use from the city's 2025 Notice of Preparation; nothing is adopted. Approximate zones, not buildings.

controls.label: road-line pixels vs OpenStreetMap: trimmed RMS over the closest 80% of 11253 points
SR-12 and SR-113 casings vs OpenStreetMap: trimmed RMS over the closest 80% of 1396 points

georeference.note: Figure 5 fitted to existing roads in its base map (SR-12, SR-113 and seven county roads) by trimmed ICP: about 12.9 m per pixel, RMS 19 m. Figure 2 uses the site boundary's SR-12 / SR-113 fit (about 20 m per pixel, RMS 32 m). Zones are clipped to the site boundary; Area Plan zones exclude the Specific Plan zones.

properties.license: Zone shapes: traced from a public City of Suisun City CEQA notice. Georeference: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0), via Overture Maps.

properties.label: Proposed commercial mixed use (CMU)
properties.source: traced: Suisun Expansion Project Notice of Preparation (City of Suisun City, SCH 2025110452, Nov 2025), Figure 5, Specific Plan Land Use Zones, p. 18
properties.note: Downtown and two district centres: offices, higher-density housing, hotels, hospitals, larger retail, civic and cultural uses (NOP p. 5). Table 1 (p. 7): up to 33,501 homes and 29.7M sq ft non-residential at full buildout. About 857 acres as drawn; the NOP states about 868 acres. Approximate: traced from a small-scale figure. Proposed, not adopted.

properties.label: Proposed industry and technology (IT)
properties.source: traced: Suisun Expansion Project Notice of Preparation (City of Suisun City, SCH 2025110452, Nov 2025), Figure 5, Specific Plan Land Use Zones, p. 18
properties.note: Manufacturing, research, industrial and infrastructure uses such as data centres and plants; no housing (NOP p. 5). Table 1 (p. 7): up to 51.9M sq ft non-residential. About 2,244 acres as drawn; the NOP states about 2,272 acres. Approximate: traced from a small-scale figure. Proposed, not adopted.

properties.label: Proposed maker and manufacturing (MM)
properties.source: traced: Suisun Expansion Project Notice of Preparation (City of Suisun City, SCH 2025110452, Nov 2025), Figure 5, Specific Plan Land Use Zones, p. 18
properties.note: Small businesses, light industry, entertainment and housing mixed (NOP p. 6). Table 1 (p. 7): up to 18,259 homes and 14.0M sq ft non-residential. About 680 acres as drawn; the NOP states about 698 acres. Approximate: traced from a small-scale figure. Proposed, not adopted.

properties.label: Proposed neighborhood mixed use (NMU)
properties.source: traced: Suisun Expansion Project Notice of Preparation (City of Suisun City, SCH 2025110452, Nov 2025), Figure 5, Specific Plan Land Use Zones, p. 18
properties.note: Predominantly residential, with smaller workplaces, schools, shops and parks (NOP p. 6). The text splits it by Travis AFB compatibility zone (C: 2,463 acres, row homes; D: 4,133 acres, row homes and multi-family) but Figure 5 doesn't draw that line. Table 1 (p. 7): up to 122,153 homes in all. About 6,531 acres as drawn; the NOP states about 6,596 acres. Approximate: traced from a small-scale figure. Proposed, not adopted.

properties.label: Proposed open space civic (OSC)
properties.source: traced: Suisun Expansion Project Notice of Preparation (City of Suisun City, SCH 2025110452, Nov 2025), Figure 5, Specific Plan Land Use Zones, p. 18
properties.note: Central Park around the Big Ditch: recreation and civic gathering places (NOP p. 6). About 845 acres as drawn; the NOP states about 865 acres. Approximate: traced from a small-scale figure. Proposed, not adopted.

properties.label: Proposed open space infrastructure (OSI)
properties.source: traced: Suisun Expansion Project Notice of Preparation (City of Suisun City, SCH 2025110452, Nov 2025), Figure 5, Specific Plan Land Use Zones, p. 18
properties.note: At the edge of the plan: water, waste, solar and energy-storage systems, with trails, conservation areas and buffers (NOP p. 6). Category other: mainly infrastructure. About 2,734 acres as drawn; the NOP states about 2,967 acres. Approximate: traced from a small-scale figure. Proposed, not adopted.

properties.label: Proposed open space (OS)
properties.source: traced: Suisun Expansion Project Notice of Preparation (City of Suisun City, SCH 2025110452, Nov 2025), Figure 5, Specific Plan Land Use Zones, p. 18
properties.note: Recreation, natural and agricultural land, including existing conservation easements (NOP p. 6). About 1,158 acres as drawn; the NOP states about 1,319 acres. Approximate: traced from a small-scale figure. Proposed, not adopted.

properties.label: Proposed area plan: Travis Protection Zone
properties.source: traced: Suisun Expansion Project Notice of Preparation (City of Suisun City, SCH 2025110452, Nov 2025), Figure 2, Annexation Area, Area Plan, Specific Plan, and 20 Year Plan Boundaries, p. 15
properties.note: Buffer for Travis Air Force Base operations that would keep the development restrictions of the county's Exclusive Agricultural zone (NOP p. 5). Category other: agricultural land, no new community. About 5,675 acres as drawn; the NOP states about 5,726 acres. Approximate: traced from a small-scale figure. Proposed, not adopted.

properties.label: Proposed area plan: Lambie Industrial Park
properties.source: traced: Suisun Expansion Project Notice of Preparation (City of Suisun City, SCH 2025110452, Nov 2025), Figure 2, Annexation Area, Area Plan, Specific Plan, and 20 Year Plan Boundaries, p. 15
properties.note: Existing industrial park; the Area Plan would keep it for industrial uses as under the county's MG-3 zoning (NOP p. 5). About 1,348 acres as drawn; the NOP states about 1,410 acres. Approximate: traced from a small-scale figure. Proposed, not adopted.
